visual.name: zentrixCalendarHeatmap
visual.description: A clean, performant, full-year GitHub-style calendar heatmap with strong tooltips, cross-filtering, anomaly markers, and accessibility.

dataRoles.description: Required. A date or date/time column — one row per day. Each day becomes a cell in the calendar grid.
dataRoles.name: date

dataRoles.description: Required. A numeric measure or column shown for each day; its magnitude sets the cell's color intensity. Multiple values on the same day are combined using the Aggregate setting (Sum, Average, Min, Max or Count).
dataRoles.name: value

dataRoles.description: Optional. A category column (e.g. Region, Product, Team). When bound, the visual renders one small-multiple calendar per category value, all sharing the same date axis and — by default — the same color scale for easy comparison.
dataRoles.name: category

dataRoles.description: Optional. A numeric goal or benchmark for each day. The tooltip shows the day's value against this target (over / under, and the % variance). Combined per day using the same Aggregate setting as Value.
dataRoles.name: target

dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more extra measures or fields to show in each cell's hover tooltip, alongside the date and value.
dataRoles.name: tooltips

dataRoles.description: Optional. A holiday name for the day, e.g. a text column set to First, or a text measure. Holiday days are marked on the grid, the same way as weekends, and named in the tooltip. Leave it blank on normal days.
dataRoles.name: holiday

dataRoles.description: Optional. What happened on the day (a launch, a campaign, an outage), from your data. The day gets an event marker and the event is listed in the tooltip. Several events on one day can be separated with ; or | (for example CONCATENATEX(Events, Events[Name], "; ")).
dataRoles.name: event

dataRoles.description: Optional. A category for the day's event (e.g. Release, Campaign, Incident). Each type gets its own marker colour and a key under the grid.
dataRoles.name: eventType
